risks: Inspected files may change during root wave0/dependency integration; hash-bound evidence must be rejected or refreshed, not attributed to the dispatch HEAD blindly.

Gmail labels and Microsoft folders/categories plus delta/send guarantees differ. Exact ManageLabel semantics and unsupported capability behavior require accepted contract decisions, not a false common success.
AccountHint/email-based or sanitized global credential keys can collide or misbind accounts. OAuth immutable subject/tenant verification is required before adopting an account.
A late refresh or open response from the former account can leak content despite raw message-ID race protection; account generation fencing is necessary.
Provider send acceptance is not independently verified delivery; timeouts/restarts require WP-19 reconciliation and UNKNOWN_EXTERNAL_EFFECT rather than blind retry.

Callback state consumption, external credential storage and domain commit are not inherently one transaction; recovery and token-generation concurrency must be defined by the accepted secret/reference contracts.
Persisted watch/subscription renewal, validation/lifecycle and bounded 429 handling are not supplied by the existing JMAP SSE reconnect loop.

Root transport/preload/render/search/mention/notification/activity/agent integrations are not proven by inspecting a local hook or planned new files; full completeness cannot be marked N/A or delegated to a later aggregate release.
Generic errorResult forwards arbitrary error messages. Provider token exchange/refresh errors must be sanitized without swallowing typed scope/tenant/reauth failures.
Repeated normative new files and provider_sync_cursor migration overlap with predecessor ownership. Independent creation would create competing interfaces/stores and schema drift.
The strict primary command payload and additional OAuth DTOs/error vocabularies need integration mapping; do not silently weaken additionalProperties:false.

Real Gmail/Microsoft OAuth accounts, provider app registration, callback/webhook reachability and independent read-back are execution prerequisites, not supplied or tested by preflight. Microsoft is explicitly new ROX behavior, not Macro-tested capability.
